note: Repetition control for Kumulus sell-side writing (Plan §14). These words are NOT banned — they are the house vocabulary — but they must not repeat mechanically across adjacent slides/bullets. Counts are observed in the 753 real Bones+Torino bullets; the highest counts are the biggest repetition risks. When a flagged word appears, prefer a listed alternative or restructure the sentence.

recurring.note: core term — keep, but vary the surrounding structure; alternate with 'repeat', 'predictable', 'contracted', 'installed-base-driven'

rules: Do not open two consecutive bullets with the same verb or the same '<X> is driven by <Y>' shape.
No more than one Class-B superlative per bullet; no unsupported Class-C superlatives.
Vary sentence length across a bullet block (mix compact label-style with two-part sentences).
Across adjacent slides, rotate the connective verb (driven by / reflects / supported by / results from).

avoid: Revenue growth is driven by increased sales.
Margin expansion is driven by improved product mix.
Recurring revenue is driven by the installed base.
prefer: Revenue growth reflects continued penetration of existing accounts and expansion into adjacent markets.
A favourable shift toward proprietary products supports further margin expansion.
The growing installed base generates recurring maintenance, upgrade and replacement revenue.
